artifact.reason: Policy entity defines basic structure (id, type, customerId, status, premium, dates). Need to understand all fields to display correctly.
Defines policy type enum (MOTOR, ENDOWMENT, HOUSE, COMMERCIAL). Used for conditional rendering of type-specific fields.
Motor-specific policy fields (vehicleRegistration, vehicleModel, coverageType). Loaded separately based on policy type.
Provides GET /api/v1/policies/{id} endpoint that returns policy details + type-specific fields. This is primary API for this story.

java.package: Vaadin framework with Spring Boot integration
Spring Web for REST client calls
Vaadin FormLayout, RouterLink, Button, Badge components

constraint.title: Polymorphic Type-Specific Fields
constraint.description: Policy detail must handle four different policy types (MOTOR, ENDOWMENT, HOUSE, COMMERCIAL) with distinct type-specific fields. Use conditional rendering based on policy.type enum. Display type-specific section only if policy is that type.

constraint.title: Read-Only Display
constraint.description: All fields must be displayed as read-only (no inline editing). Use Vaadin read-only FormLayout or Labels. Editing will be implemented in future Policy Edit story.

constraint.title: Vaadin Routing with Parameters
constraint.description: Use Vaadin @Route("/policies/{id}") with RouteParameters to extract policy ID from URL. Convert parameter to UUID for API call.

constraint.title: Material Design 3 Styling
constraint.description: Follow Material Design 3 color palette and spacing. Ensure consistent styling with other Vaadin pages (Story 3.5 Customer Detail for pattern).

constraint.title: Responsive 2-Column to 1-Column
constraint.description: Desktop layout: 2-column (basic details left, type-specific right). Mobile (<768px): 1-column (stacked vertically). All text readable without horizontal scrolling.

constraint.title: Customer Navigation
constraint.description: Customer name must be clickable link (RouterLink) to /customers/{customerId}. Must include customerId in policy API response to enable navigation.

constraint.title: Breadcrumb Navigation
constraint.description: Display breadcrumb path: Dashboard > Policies > {Policy Number}. Breadcrumbs should be clickable to navigate back.

constraint.title: Error Handling
constraint.description: Handle 404 "Policy not found", API errors, and network failures gracefully with user-friendly messages and retry options.

interface.name: Policy Detail API
interface.description: Retrieve full policy details including basic fields and type-specific attributes. Response includes policy type to enable conditional rendering in UI.

interface.name: Vaadin Router
interface.description: Page routing and navigation. Extract policy ID from URL parameter, navigate to customer detail on link click, navigate back to policy list on back button.

interface.name: Vaadin FormLayout
interface.signature: FormLayout with read-only fields (TextField, Label, Badge)
interface.description: Display policy details in organized form-like layout. Use read-only TextFields or Labels for display.
